newsitem.title: UK: Argentina plans 500 bln lire 7-year bond - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Argentina plans 500 bln lire 7-year bond - dealers.

text.p: Argentina plans to issue a 500 billion lire seven-year bond next week, syndicate managers said on Friday.
SBC Warburg was tipped as lead manager, but declined to comment on the transaction.
Dealers elsewhere said the paper was likely to pay an 11 percent coupon and yield around 310 basis points over the Italian swap curve.
Argentina last tapped the sector in June with a 350 billion lire three-year bond. It also has lira paper outstanding due in 1997 and 2001.
